title: b7z9.35(a): Rust gateway — wire tunnel_auth into dispatch + egress forwarding path
description: Child of b7z9.35 (spec 06-security.md:703-705, 727-807). lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs is exported (lib.rs:20) and library-tested (tests/tunnel_auth_vectors.rs, vectors test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json) but gateway.rs never uses it. Wire: (1) the tunnel-auth permit/deny check into the egress decapsulation/forwarding path (gateway.rs mesh-to-internet direction — drop unauthorized tunnels before forwarding, computing route_hash from the Source-Route Header); (2) the POST /.well-known/tunnel-auth resource (COSE_Sign1 alg -65537) registration in the gateway's CoAP dispatch. Mind the permit()/deny() 204/403 mapping convention (C tunnel_auth.c:24-33 analog). Tests: extend tunnel_auth_vectors.rs with the wired-path cases.
close_reason: Verified already fully landed on beads-worker-2 (via earlier swarm merges); closed with evidence. Acceptance: (1) egress permit/deny wired — egress_tunnel_authorized (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1397) called from ingest_mesh_frame_at_superframe, fails closed on denial, hairpin bypasses, unprovisioned table keeps gate open (C s_tunnel_ready==false parity), route evidence = gateway's own IID via rpl_stack.local_iid() (post-AddrForKey correct); (2) POST /.well-known/tunnel-auth dispatch wired (gateway.rs:1567-1574 -> coordinator.handle_post_tunnel_auth, COSE_Sign1 alg -65537, fail-closed 4.03); (3) wired-path tests present and GREEN: tunnel_auth_vectors.rs 13/13 incl. wired_coap_tunnel_auth_accepts_valid_vector_then_replay_is_forbidden, wired_coap_tunnel_auth_fails_closed_on_missing_oscore_wrong_root_and_wrong_egress, wired_egress_{forwards_authorized_tunnel,matches_grant_under_distinct_root_via_own_iid_route_evidence,drops_unauthorized_tunnel,drops_source_outside_granted_prefix,refuses_expired_grant_and_stays_closed,hairpin_bypasses_gate}; full lichen-gateway suite 269 lib + all integration suites 0 failures. NOTE: initial run showed 2 phantom wired_egress failures + phantom E0599/E0061 compile errors caused by shared-CARGO_TARGET_DIR stale artifacts from a concurrent worker (file lock observed); cargo clean -p lichen-node -p lichen-gateway fixed it — evidence commented on project-LICHEN-worker6-xrue. My only commit: 24978edacb removing 2 debug eprintlns the janitor swept into sync commit 5d5004847f. Codereview 3x: all passes (correctness/security/edge-cases) PASS self-conducted — reviewer opencode run timed out on both attempts (400s each), noted per protocol. No findings.
